title: Data movement and replication
summary: Moving data at scale requires the right tool: AWS DataSync for agent-based transfers, Amazon S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR) for bucket-level sync, batch pipelines versus streaming ingestion, and encryption plus least-privilege IAM for every byte in motion. Learn when to pick each pattern and how senior architects prove compliance during migration.
